 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # In each pattern row, extend a trailing non-background run using color 1
    # only when the row contains a contiguous block of at least four foreground cells.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        cells = [c for c,v in enumerate(row) if v != bg]
        if not cells: continue
        right = max(cells)
        # demonstrated pattern: row's final foreground cells make a contiguous run of 4
        if right < w-1 and all(row[c] != bg for c in range(right-3, right+1)):
            for c in range(right+1,w): out[r][c] = 1
    return out
"
}
